title: 熔点测定（国内版）
source_doc: course/MIT Digital Lab Techniques Manual/12_Melting Point.md
author_source: project/MIT Digital Lab Techniques Manual/12_Melting Point（国内版）/src.py

points.K21: 熔点低、熔程宽，多半不纯

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台带目镜的熔点仪旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a benchtop melting point apparatus with an eyepiece, a heating block and a blank digital thermometer, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课学熔点测定。

shots.scene: 放大镜下毛细管里的白色晶体
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a thin glass capillary filled at the bottom with white crystals. No people.
shots.narration: 一根细管、几粒晶体，就能看出纯不纯。

shots.scene: 阿杰举着一瓶刚重结晶的白色晶体
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds up a vial of freshly recrystallized white crystals and looks proud.
shots.narration: 阿杰做完重结晶，想知道晶体纯不纯。

shots.scene: 阿杰把电压旋钮一下拧到最大
shots.prompt_en: The young male student turns the knob of the melting point apparatus all the way up at once.
shots.narration: 他把加热旋钮一拧到底，想快点出结果。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指着温度计
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points at the thermometer display.
shots.narration: 小研说：太快就不准了，还容易烫手。

shots.scene: 欣欣一手拿晶体瓶，一手拿问号卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a vial of crystals in one paw and a blank card with a question mark in the other.
shots.narration: 晶体纯不纯？是不是那个化合物？

shots.scene: 温度计图标连着勾号和放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon linked to a check mark icon and a magnifying glass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 测一测熔点，两个问题都能回答。

shots.scene: 蓝色小球排成整齐晶格，小幅振动
shots.prompt_en: Animated blue spheres arranged in a neat cubic lattice, each vibrating slightly in place. No people.
shots.narration: 晶体里，分子间的引力把分子拉住。

shots.scene: 小火苗图标，小球振动越来越大
shots.prompt_en: A small heat icon appears and the spheres vibrate more and more strongly. No people.
shots.narration: 加热后，分子动能变大，温度升高。

shots.scene: 晶格散开，小球自由流动
shots.prompt_en: The lattice breaks apart and the spheres flow freely like a liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 动能胜过引力，晶格瓦解，变成液体。

shots.scene: 固体与液体在天平两端平衡
shots.prompt_en: A balance icon with a solid cube on one side and a droplet on the other, perfectly level. No people.
shots.narration: 一定压力下固液平衡的温度，叫熔点。

shots.scene: 温度条上一段被高亮
shots.prompt_en: A horizontal temperature bar with a short highlighted band. No people.
shots.narration: 其实固体是在一段温度内熔化的。

shots.scene: 同一个化合物三次测定，高亮段重合
shots.prompt_en: Three temperature bars stacked, each with the same highlighted band lining up. No people.
shots.narration: 纯物质的这段范围可以重复。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着高亮段
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the highlighted band on a big temperature bar.
shots.narration: 所以说熔点，其实说的是熔程。

shots.scene: 熔点仪部件示意：开关、样品座、灯、目镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of the melting point apparatus with arrows to a power switch, a sample holder, a lamp and an eyepiece. No people.
shots.narration: 熔点仪有开关、样品座、照明灯和目镜。

shots.scene: 数字温度计和电压旋钮
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a blank digital thermometer and a numbered voltage knob on the apparatus. No people.
shots.narration: 还有数字温度计和电压旋钮。

shots.scene: 旋钮转高，升温箭头变陡
shots.prompt_en: The voltage knob turns higher and a temperature rise arrow becomes steeper. No people.
shots.narration: 电压越高，升温越快。

shots.scene: 旋钮停住，温度仍在上升
shots.prompt_en: The knob stays still while the thermometer keeps climbing, with a warning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它管快慢，不管温度停在哪。

shots.scene: 加热块上的高温警示标识
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the heating block with a hot surface warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 熔点仪随时当作是热的。

shots.scene: 手去摸加热块的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand touching the heating block, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 尤其是标着当心烫的地方，别用手碰。

shots.scene: 台面上的刮勺、表面皿、研钵、毛细管、长颈漏斗
shots.prompt_en: On a bench: a spatula, a watch glass, a mortar and pestle, thin capillary tubes sealed at one end, and a long-stem funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 备好刮勺、表面皿、研钵、毛细管。

shots.scene: 长颈漏斗高亮
shots.prompt_en: The long-stem funnel glows. No people.
shots.narration: 再来一根长玻璃管，比如长颈漏斗。

shots.scene: 干净干燥的晶体，勾号
shots.prompt_en: Clean dry white crystals on a watch glass with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 样品一定要干净、干燥。

shots.scene: 滤纸按压吸干湿晶体
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand presses a filter paper on damp crystals to blot them dry.
shots.narration: 湿的话，用滤纸吸一吸。

shots.scene: 样品放进烘箱的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a sample dish going into an oven, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别放烘箱，可能熔掉或分解。

shots.scene: 研钵里研磨大颗晶体
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand grinds large crystals with a pestle in a mortar.
shots.narration: 大颗晶体，先用研钵研细。

shots.scene: 大颗粒之间有空隙，热量传得慢
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of big crystals in a tube with air gaps and slow heat arrows, next to fine packed powder with even heat arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 大颗粒堆不紧有空隙，受热不均。

shots.scene: 刮勺平头碾碎晶体
shots.prompt_en: The flat end of a spatula crushes crystals on a watch glass. No people.
shots.narration: 没有研钵，就用刮勺平头碾。

shots.scene: 研细的粉末放在表面皿上
shots.prompt_en: Fine powder heaped on a watch glass. No people.
shots.narration: 研细的晶体放到表面皿上。

shots.scene: 毛细管开口朝下戳进粉末
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand holds a capillary open end down and gently pokes it into the powder.
shots.narration: 毛细管开口朝下，轻戳几下，带进一点。

shots.scene: 毛细管正过来在台面轻敲
shots.prompt_en: The capillary is turned upright and tapped gently on the bench.
shots.narration: 正过来，轻敲让晶体落到底。

shots.scene: 毛细管从长颈漏斗颈里落下
shots.prompt_en: The capillary is dropped down through the stem of an upside-down long-stem funnel onto the bench.
shots.narration: 落不下，就让它从长玻璃管里掉下去。

shots.scene: 重复几次，粉末压得紧实
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the capillary bottom with powder packed tight and no gaps. No people.
shots.narration: 重复几次，压紧，不留空隙。

shots.scene: 毛细管底部样品高约一毫米，尺子标出
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a capillary with about one millimeter of packed powder, a tiny ruler beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 样品越少越好，压实约一毫米。

shots.scene: 装得太多的毛细管被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A capillary filled with a tall column of powder, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 超过两毫米，受热不均就不准。

shots.scene: 四支装好样品的毛细管并排
shots.prompt_en: Four filled capillaries side by side; the first is set apart from the other three. No people.
shots.narration: 一份样品装四支。

shots.scene: 三支毛细管放在一起
shots.prompt_en: The three capillaries on the right are grouped with a bracket. No people.
shots.narration: 一支测粗熔点，三支平行测定。

shots.scene: 问号和温度计图标
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon with a question mark over it. No people.
shots.narration: 不知道大概熔点？先测个粗熔点。

shots.scene: 旋钮回零，等仪器凉下来
shots.prompt_en: The voltage knob is turned to zero and a clock icon waits while the block cools. No people.
shots.narration: 电压调零，等仪器冷到室温。

shots.scene: 插入毛细管，快速升温，记下大概温度
shots.prompt_en: A capillary is inserted into the holder; a fast rising arrow and a blank note card appear.
shots.narration: 插样，每分钟升十到二十度，记个大概。

shots.scene: 小研把电压调零，打开电源和温度计
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns the knob to zero, then switches on the apparatus and the thermometer.
shots.narration: 正式测：电压调零，开电源和温度计。

shots.scene: 毛细管轻轻插进样品座
shots.prompt_en: A capillary is slid gently into the sample holder.
shots.narration: 装好的毛细管插进样品座。

shots.scene: 温度离预期还远时升温箭头较陡
shots.prompt_en: A temperature bar far below a target line, with a steep rising arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 离预期熔点还差二十度以上，可以快升。

shots.scene: 温度接近目标线，旋钮调低
shots.prompt_en: As the reading nears the target line, the knob is turned down. No people.
shots.narration: 进入熔点前二十度，调低电压。

shots.scene: 升温箭头变得平缓
shots.prompt_en: The rising arrow becomes gentle and slow. No people.
shots.narration: 每分钟只升一到二度。

shots.scene: 小研从目镜观察
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks through the eyepiece of the melting point apparatus.
shots.narration: 从目镜里盯着样品。

shots.scene: 晶体中出现第一滴液体
shots.prompt_en: Magnified view of crystals in the capillary with the first tiny liquid droplet appearing. No people.
shots.narration: 出现第一滴液体，记下温度。

shots.scene: 最后一粒晶体消失，全是液体
shots.prompt_en: Magnified view as the last crystal disappears and the capillary holds only clear liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 最后一粒晶体消失，再记一次。

shots.scene: 电压调低，取出毛细管放进废物盒
shots.prompt_en: The knob is turned down and the used capillary is dropped into a broken glass box.
shots.narration: 调低电压，取出用过的管子丢掉。

shots.scene: 温度计读数下降
shots.prompt_en: The thermometer reading drops back below a line twenty degrees under the target. No people.
shots.narration: 等仪器降到熔点以下二十度。

shots.scene: 另两支毛细管依次测定
shots.prompt_en: The remaining two capillaries are measured one after the other, three readings lining up. No people.
shots.narration: 再测另外两支，看能不能重现。

shots.scene: 熔过又凝固的样品再次加热的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a melted and re-solidified capillary going back into the heater, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 熔过的样品，不要再熔一次。

shots.scene: 分子图标变形、断开
shots.prompt_en: Molecule icons twisting, breaking and rearranging with small heat lines. No people.
shots.narration: 加热时它可能氧化、分解或重排了。

shots.scene: 晶体下沉、收缩的放大画面，问号
shots.prompt_en: Magnified view of crystals settling and shrinking in the capillary, with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 样品下沉、变软、收缩，还不算熔。

shots.scene: 第一滴液体出现，勾号
shots.prompt_en: Magnified view of the first liquid droplet with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 看到第一滴液体，才是开始熔化。

shots.section_title: 熔点低、熔程宽，多半不纯
shots.scene: 晶格中混进一个不同颜色的小球
shots.prompt_en: A neat lattice of blue spheres with one orange sphere wedged in, weakening the links around it. No people.
shots.narration: 杂质会扰乱晶格，削弱分子间引力。
overlay: 熔点低、熔程宽，多半不纯

shots.section_title: 熔点低、熔程宽，多半不纯
shots.scene: 温度条上高亮段左移且变宽
shots.prompt_en: Two temperature bars: the pure sample's narrow band, and the impure sample's band shifted lower and wider. No people.
shots.narration: 熔点变低，熔程变宽。

shots.section_title: 熔点低、熔程宽，多半不纯
shots.scene: 熔程宽度标尺超过几度的警示
shots.prompt_en: A width marker on a wide band with a warning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 熔程超过两三度，多半不纯。

shots.scene: 小研翻阅空白参考书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student runs her finger down a table in a thick blank reference book.
shots.narration: 鉴定未知物，和手册里的熔点比一比。

shots.scene: 温度条只标出上端
shots.prompt_en: A temperature band with only its upper end marked by a flag. No people.
shots.narration: 手册通常只列熔程的上限。

shots.scene: 四张空白光谱图
shots.prompt_en: Four blank spectrum charts with simple peak lines and no text. No people.
shots.narration: 再结合光谱数据，才可能确定。

shots.scene: 三只表面皿装不同比例的混合样品
shots.prompt_en: Three watch glasses each holding a small mixed powder sample. No people.
shots.narration: 把未知物和推测的化合物混在一起。

shots.scene: 三份混合物熔程完全一致，勾号
shots.prompt_en: Three temperature bars with identical bands and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 三份熔点、熔程都一样，可能就是它。

shots.scene: 三份熔程不一致，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three temperature bars with bands that shift and widen, and a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不一样，肯定不是它。

shots.scene: 升温箭头过陡，警示图标
shots.prompt_en: A very steep temperature rise arrow with a warning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 最常见的错误：升温太快。

shots.scene: 加热块已经很热，毛细管里还是冷的
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a hot red heating block around a capillary that is still blue inside, with a lag clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 管子来不及跟上加热块的温度。

shots.scene: 高亮段变窄、整体偏高
shots.prompt_en: A measured band that looks narrower and sits higher than the true band. No people.
shots.narration: 测出来熔程偏窄，熔点偏高。

shots.scene: 毛细管里的样品慢慢变少消失
shots.prompt_en: Magnified view of powder in the capillary slowly vanishing into vapor lines. No people.
shots.narration: 加热时样品不见了？那是在升华。

shots.scene: 毛细管开口端在火焰中封口
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand holds the open end of a filled capillary in a small blue burner flame to seal it, inside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 可先把开口端用灯焰封住，再测。

shots.scene: 毛细管中白色样品变成褐色
shots.prompt_en: Magnified view of white powder turning brown in the capillary. No people.
shots.narration: 加热时变色，多半在分解。

shots.scene: 记录本上写熔点后加一个标记
shots.prompt_en: A blank notebook with a temperature line and an extra mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 报告熔点时，要注明有分解。

shots.scene: 四瓶熔点已知的标准物质
shots.prompt_en: Four small bottles of pure reference compounds with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 熔点总不对？用标准物质校准仪器。

shots.scene: 分别测定，读数与已知值对比
shots.prompt_en: Four measured values next to four known values, with small difference arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 选几种熔点相差较大的，逐个测定。

shots.scene: 实际值对观测值的校准直线
shots.prompt_en: A simple graph with points along a straight calibration line, axes without text. No people.
shots.narration: 以实际值对测得值作校准曲线。

shots.scene: 从曲线上查出样品真实熔点
shots.prompt_en: A dashed line from the observed value on the graph up to the line and across to the true value. No people.
shots.narration: 用曲线换算样品的真实熔点。

shots.scene: 少、紧、慢三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a tiny pinch of powder, a packed capillary, and a slow turtle. No people.
shots.narration: 样品要少，装得要紧，升温要慢。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起毛细管竖大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a capillary and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 熔点，是判断纯度和身份的好帮手。

shots.scene: 未知样品瓶上只有问号
shots.prompt_en: A vial with a blank label showing only a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 未知样品，一律当作有毒的对待。

shots.scene: 凑近闻、用手捏的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of sniffing a vial and pinching powder with bare fingers, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 不闻、不尝、不用手碰。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜手套，用刮勺取一点点
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in goggles and gloves, takes a tiny amount with a spatula.
shots.narration: 戴好手套护目镜，只取需要的一点。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴护目镜轻轻研磨，量很少
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears safety goggles and gently grinds a small amount in a mortar.
shots.narration: 研磨时戴护目镜，量少、动作轻。

shots.scene: 两种不同的粉末倒进同一研钵的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two different powders, one marked with an oxidizer pictogram, poured into the same mortar, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 氧化剂不能和可燃物、还原剂一起研。

shots.scene: 研钵用后清洗干净
shots.prompt_en: A mortar and pestle being rinsed and wiped clean at a sink.
shots.narration: 研钵用完洗净，别混进下一个样品。

shots.scene: 手指捏住毛细管靠近底部，轻轻插入
shots.prompt_en: Gloved fingers hold the capillary close to its lower end and slide it gently into the holder.
shots.narration: 插毛细管，手捏靠下的位置，轻轻送。

shots.scene: 用力硬按、毛细管折断扎手的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a capillary snapping under force and pricking a finger, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 插不进别硬按，折断了会扎手。

shots.scene: 断管放进碎玻璃盒
shots.prompt_en: A broken capillary is placed into a rigid broken glass box with tweezers. No people.
shots.narration: 断管用镊子夹进碎玻璃盒。

shots.scene: 封口毛细管加热时出现裂纹的示意
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a sealed capillary in the heating block with pressure arrows inside and small crack lines. No people.
shots.narration: 封口管加热，内部压力会升高。

shots.scene: 小研测封口管时戴护目镜，脸离加热块远一点
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears goggles and keeps her face back from the heating block, looking only through the eyepiece.
shots.narration: 戴护目镜，只从目镜看，别凑近加热块。

shots.scene: 熔点仪放在通风处，分解的烟被排走
shots.prompt_en: The melting point apparatus sits near an exhaust vent; faint fumes from a decomposing sample drift into the vent. No people.
shots.narration: 样品会分解冒烟的，在通风处测。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现研钵和毛细管图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a mortar and a packed capillary.
shots.narration: 研细、装紧、只装一毫米。

shots.scene: 粗测和精测的升温箭头
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a steep arrow and a gentle arrow side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 先粗测，再在熔点前慢慢升温。

shots.scene: 第一滴液体和最后一粒晶体图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a first droplet and a last vanishing crystal. No people.
shots.narration: 记初熔、全熔，测三次，不重熔。

shots.scene: 宽熔程、混合样品、校准曲线图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a wide band, three mixed samples and a calibration line. No people.
shots.narration: 熔程宽多半不纯，混合熔点来验证。

shots.scene: 护目镜、碎玻璃盒、问号瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of safety goggles, a broken glass box and a vial with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 未知当有毒，研磨有禁忌，碎管不扎手。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着毛细管挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a capillary and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 测得准，用得稳，下次见！
